title: Altered Suds
specs: Brewery destination with a speakeasy feel built from scratch with passion for beer, music, art, and all things a little weird
Live music every first Sunday of the month with Sweet Little Andy
Plan your own private gathering or simply drop by to meet friends or family
blurb: Altered Suds brews craft beer and provides a welcoming place to drink it. They host live music events every first Sunday of the month. Guests can bring outside food or order from Molly's Irish Pub upstairs, which offers limited pub menu table service in the brewery.
